descriptionChirho: A large serpent or snake, especially the serpent into which Moses' rod was transformed (Exodus 7) and similar threatening serpent imagery.
A great sea creature or marine monster, including the sea creatures God created (Genesis 1:21) and the sea monsters of Job and Psalms.
A mythological dragon or cosmic chaos monster used in prophetic and apocalyptic imagery, often representing hostile nations or primordial adversaries (Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Psalms).
